evidence: app/src/app.js:253-267 — ability route lives in the single flat route file, not a feature module
app/src/app.js:28 — abilityPage import must be pruned by hand
app/src/app.js:193-197 — abilities data prep is inlined in the pokemon route, not next to the ability code
app/src/views/pokemon.js:55-62,128 — the pokemon page's Abilities section links to /abilities and must be dropped too
app/src/views/components.js:14,22 — the 'hidden' flag in the shared pokemonCard exists only for the ability page and would be left dead
removability.rationale: Removing Abilities is a findable handful of scattered edits across three files (app.js, pokemon.js, components.js) with a risk of leaving a dead flag in a shared component — exactly the 3 anchor, not the 'delete a route and a nav link' case.

evidence: app/src/views/components.js:17 — sprite URL built in one place; all four card lists route through pokemonCard (app/src/app.js:72, 222)
app/src/app.js:88,142,190,244 — type-label resolution 'labels.get(x) ?? humanize(x)' duplicated at ~6 sites with no shared helper
app/src/app.js:72 + app/src/views/components.js:21 — Map passed where an object is indexed; the latent fallback only works because type names are single words
app/src/views/home.js:5-15 — pageUrl is a single place for filter-URL building, a good counter-example
app/src/app.js:58-72 vs 208-222 — card lists are constructed in two independent places, so cross-list changes are a two-site fix
changeability.rationale: The headline bug fix (sprite per species) lands in one obvious line and covers every list, but several other behaviours (type labels, card-list assembly) are duplicated across 2-6 sites, and the Map/object mismatch shows duplication already producing a latent defect.

evidence: app/src/views/components.js:2,17 — a view template imports API_BASE from the data layer and constructs media URLs itself
app/src/views/details.js:59,68 vs app/src/app.js:72,297 — the same 'typeLabels' concept is passed as a Map in one route and Object.fromEntries in another, with pokemonCard defaulting to {}
app/src/app.js:19-20 vs app/src/views/layout.js:12-15 — static asset paths are listed in both the route loop and the layout head
app/src/public/app.js:31-60 — client script is standalone, event-delegated, no server knowledge (good)
app/src/views/pokemon.js:95-141 + app/src/app.js:167-169 — movesSection serves both the page and the htmx fragment through one seam (good)
coupling.rationale: Views get plain props and server/client code are cleanly separated, but the view layer reaches into the data layer for the API base URL, and one prop is passed in three different shapes depending on the route — tangles a maintainer can trip on.

evidence: app/src/app.js:208-222 — speciesCardsFor is designed around the data's real variation (bare vs wrapped refs, extra-note callback) instead of three copied loops
app/src/views/components.js:26-30 — section() encodes the region/aria-labelledby convention exactly once
app/src/views/home.js:17-31 — resultsFragment doubles as the htmx partial; app/src/views/pokemon.js:88-141 does the same for moves
app/src/format.js — every naming rule (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor, orMissing) centralized
app/src/views/components.js:14 — minor flag creep: pokemonCard carries page-specific optional flags (types, hidden, typeLabels)
app/src/views/details.js:32,38,77 — 'count Pokémon + cardList' snippet inlined three times rather than a countedList helper
abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions (speciesCardsFor, section, the partial-seam views, format.js) stretch to new cases with little copying — an Items section would reuse most of the Moves machinery — held back only by small flag creep in pokemonCard and a thrice-inlined count/list snippet.

findings.issue: A Map is passed to pokemonCard, which indexes it with bracket syntax (app/src/views/components.js:21); the lookup is always undefined and silently falls back to humanize, working only because all type names are single words
findings.suggestion: Pick one shape for type labels (e.g. always a plain object, or always a Map with .get()) and have pokemonCard/its callers agree on it

findings.issue: A view template imports API_BASE from the data layer and hand-builds media URLs, so a change to the data source's URL scheme requires editing a view
findings.suggestion: Add a spriteUrl(id) helper in api.js (or pass sprite URLs as data) so views never know the API origin

findings.issue: Type-label resolution 'typeEnglishByName().get(x) ?? humanize(x)' is duplicated at ~6 call sites (app.js:88,142,190,244,290 and views/components.js:21)
findings.suggestion: Export a single typeLabel(name) helper (backed by the memoized map) and call it everywhere

findings.issue: Card lists are constructed in two independent places — the home route (filter/slice/map) and speciesCardsFor (app.js:208-222) — so cross-list behaviour like sorting or sprite fixes needing more data must be applied twice
findings.suggestion: Route the home page through a shared card-list builder (or give speciesCardsFor a sort/transform option) so all lists share one seam

findings.issue: pokemonCard accumulates page-specific optional flags (types=null, hidden=false, typeLabels={}), and 'hidden' exists solely for the ability page — removing that feature leaves dead parameters in a shared component
findings.suggestion: Accept a single optional 'footer' slot (badges or note) instead of named per-page flags

findings.issue: Static asset paths are enumerated in the route loop and duplicated again in the layout head (app/src/views/layout.js:12-15); adding an asset is a two-file edit
findings.suggestion: Serve /public via one wildcard route (app.use('*', serveStatic({root:'./public'}))) and keep the asset list only in the layout

findings.issue: The '<count> Pokémon' + cardList section markup is inlined three times (details.js:32,38,77) rather than one countedCardSection helper
findings.suggestion: Extract a small helper like sectionWithCount(slug, title, countText, cards) and reuse it for future Items-style pages

summary: This is a genuinely editable codebase: one data layer, one formatting module, shared components, and htmx partials that reuse the page templates rather than duplicating them, all on current stable API versions with no dead code. The named sprite bug would be a one-line fix in pokemonCard that covers every card list. The main risks are a latent Map/object typeLabels mismatch that already silently mis-resolves labels, duplicated type-label and card-list logic that makes some changes two-to-six-site edits, and the ability feature being spread across three files instead of being self-contained.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them
scenarios.notes: Edits are scattered but greppable: route + import + englishName/effect prep in app.js:28,253-267, the Abilities section in pokemon.js:55-62,128, the hidden-ability data mapping in app.js:259, the dead 'hidden' flag in components.js:14,22, and the abilityPage template in details.js:35-39. No nav link, since nav only lists Pokémon and Types.

scenarios.change: Fix the sprite shown for species whose default Pokémon has a different name (e.g. Deoxys)
scenarios.notes: Every card list renders through pokemonCard, and the sprite URL is built in exactly one line (components.js:17) from the id that speciesCardsFor (app.js:208-222) already resolves from the pokemon reference while mapping to the species name — so one fix covers home, moves, abilities and types. Only if the fix needs the API's own sprite URL per Pokémon would you additionally touch speciesCardsFor and the home index.

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards
scenarios.notes: Card lists are assembled in two places: speciesCardsFor's out.sort((a,b)=>a.id-b.id) (app.js:221) covers move/ability/type lists, while home builds its own list from the index (app.js:58-72). Both are in app.js and the card markup itself is shared, so it's a two-site change (plus a small UI/query-param hook), not one.

scenarios.change: Add an Items section (/items, /items/:name) shaped like Moves
scenarios.notes: Most machinery is reusable as-is: apiJson/memoized apiList, renderPage/renderNotFound (app.js:34-39), englishName/collapseWhitespace/orMissing from format.js, section() and cardList from components.js. What gets written rather than reused is the ~25-line route (copy of the move route shape at app.js:228-247) and an itemPage template modelled on movePage (details.js:15-33); typeListPage is type-styled so an /items index page needs its own small list template.

scenarios.change: Change the API base URL and caching rules
scenarios.notes: The base URL is read in one place (api.js:4) and the cache is a single Map inside apiJson with failure eviction (api.js:8-25), so TTL/entry-limit changes are one-file. The one leak is components.js:17, which imports API_BASE to build sprite URLs — a scheme change there means touching a view too.
